checked_by: Claude, read from worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com and the Blizzard forums

posts.title: Launch: 4 November at 15:00 PST, midnight in Europe
posts.text: WoW Forever opens worldwide on 4 November at 15:00 PST, which is 00:00 CET on 5 November (23:00 UTC). The first login asks for an Experience Preset: Classic (standard models, no quest markers, no one-bag, no transmog) or Enhanced (HD models with all of those on), changeable later in Options. Then pick a Ruleset: Normal, PvP, Roleplay or Roleplay PvP. Hardcore follows some time after launch.
posts.label: worldofwarcraft.com

posts.title: Agree on Ruleset and faction before you make characters
posts.text: Characters can group, join guilds, run dungeons and raid together only inside the same Ruleset and faction, and a PvP Ruleset holds you to one faction. Each character can spend up to 16 Legacy Points at launch, so alts are optional. The Cooldown Manager and a Damage Meter sit under Advanced options. One subscription or Game Time covers both Forever and the modern game.
posts.label: worldofwarcraft.com

posts.title: Gamepad guide
posts.text: Any XInput controller works, with Xbox and PlayStation button icons. Turn it on under Options, Gameplay, Gamepad. Hold LT, RT or both for four action bars, and LB+RB with left or right on the D-pad switches between three sets, 84 slots in all. Support is still in beta, and chat still needs a keyboard.
posts.label: worldofwarcraft.com

posts.title: Returning player guide: two-part names and a 15v15 battleground
posts.text: Forever is set in Year 1, before Kazzak reopened the Dark Portal. Every character has a first name and a second name, and the pair must be unique in your region. New combinations: Human Hunter, Dwarf Shaman, Gnome Priest, Orc Mage, Troll Warlock and Undead Paladin; Skyborne need the Heroic Pack or higher. Darkspear Islands is a new 15v15 battleground off Dustwallow Marsh for levels 30 to 60.
posts.label: worldofwarcraft.com

posts.title: Fix for names refused by mistake
posts.text: A bug made the restricted name list too strict, for example refusing any name containing "con". The fix went in with each region's next realm restart, so a name that was refused before is worth trying again.
posts.label: Blizzard forums, Kaivax

posts.title: Stress Test tonight, then the beta closes for good
posts.text: The beta goes offline on 21 October and WoW Forever opens on its regional hardware for a Stress Test, 19:00 to 03:00 CEST. Any WoW account can join, no subscription needed. Afterwards every Stress Test character, names included, is deleted and the beta reopens until it closes for good on Friday 23 October at 10:00 PDT (19:00 CEST).
posts.label: Blizzard forums, Kaivax

posts.title: Early Name Reservation, 27 October to 3 November
posts.text: Reserve names for up to three characters in total across all Rulesets. Europe opens 27 October at 18:00 CET. Requires a pre-purchase of the Skyborne Heroic Pack, the Skyborne Epic Pack or the Warcraft Forever Collection. First come, first served.
posts.label: worldofwarcraft.com

posts.title: Three level 60 raids unlock on 9 December
posts.text: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40). Onyxia needs every raid member to carry the Drakefire Amulet, earned through a faction questline that runs through Blackrock Depths and Blackrock Spire.
posts.label: worldofwarcraft.com

posts.title: Nine new five-player dungeons, level 13 to 60
posts.text: Six in the Eastern Kingdoms and three in Kalimdor, from the Hall of Thanes beneath Ironforge to Shaper's Terrace in Un'Goro. The full list is below.
posts.label: worldofwarcraft.com

posts.title: Hotfix: Cat Form can be learned again
posts.text: A beta hotfix fixed the bug that stopped Druids looting the relics for The Great Cat Spirit, so Cat Form can be unlocked.
posts.label: Blizzard forums, Kaivax

posts.title: Datamined art is not for WoW Forever
posts.text: Art assets datamined from the latest beta build are not intended for this version of World of Warcraft.
posts.label: Blizzard forums, Kaivax

dungeons.name: Hall of Thanes
dungeons.access: Easy for Alliance; Horde travel into Alliance territory.

dungeons.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
dungeons.where: Ruins above the Undercity, Tirisfal Glades
dungeons.access: Easy for Horde; Alliance travel into Horde territory.

dungeons.name: City of Dalaran
dungeons.access: Attunement: "An Alarming Request" in Southshore (Alliance), "Key to the City" and "Prison Break-In" in Tarren Mill (Horde).

dungeons.name: The Drowned City
dungeons.where: Off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, west of Grom'gol

dungeons.name: Shaper's Terrace
dungeons.access: Bring power crystals from Un'Goro for the consoles inside.

raids.name: The Barrow Deeps
raids.where: Inside Mount Hyjal; entrances from Mount Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold
raids.text: The prison that held Illidan for 10,000 years, now opened.

raids.name: Hyjal Summit
raids.where: Summit of Mount Hyjal, near Nordrassil
raids.text: Opens with an ancient guardian, then several routes across the mountain.

raids.name: Onyxia's Lair
raids.text: Fire resistance matters. Every raider needs the Drakefire Amulet.
